renderAppNav

Renders the template: logo, burger strip, and the fullscreen menu overlay. Returns '' while the media-expand modal is open — an empty render wipes the nav DOM so its z-index/focus can never compete with the modal chrome. The CTA label chain (contact → scroll-up at page bottom → related on project routes) mirrors the menu item order.

  • @param nav AppNav instance — reads its getters/state, calls delegates.
  • @returns JSX tree, or '' while a modal owns the screen.
